svg.title: One grounded question in Dispatch Advisor version 4: the host runs ask_service_data as the person
svg.desc: Sequence with five participants: Sami in Teams through C-24, the C-57 host running advisor version 4, the Foundry agent version 4, Microsoft Entra ID and the Dataverse Ask API. 1: Sami's question reaches C-57 with Sami's token. 2: C-57 sends a Responses API request to the Foundry agent. 3: the agent returns a function call to ask_service_data. 4: C-57 checks GR-1, that the token is delegated, and GR-3, that the question has 3 to 500 characters. 5: C-57 exchanges Sami's token on behalf of Sami for a Dataverse token with the scope environment URL slash user_impersonation. 6: C-57 posts to /api/iq/v1.0/ask with the model "Cedar service desk" and count 25. 7: the Ask API returns only rows Sami may read, record links and a summary, possibly with a paging token. 8: C-57 applies GR-4 to GR-9: at most 50 rows, rows marked as data, links checked against the environment and the model's tables, the fixed no-rows wording and one audit line. 9: C-57 sends the function call output back to Foundry. 10: Foundry returns the answer text. 11: C-57 applies GC-1, links only from the tool output, GC-2, the fixed text when there are no rows, and GC-3, no claims of changes, and keeps the answer or replaces it with the rows-only text. 12: Sami receives the checked answer.
svg.text: 4 GR-1 delegated token? GR-3 question of 3 to 500 characters
7 only rows Sami may read + record links + summary (+ pagingToken)
8 GR-4…GR-9: ≤ 50 rows, rows are data, links checked, no-rows wording, one audit line
11 GC-1 links · GC-2 no-rows text · GC-3 no change claims → answer or rows-only text
Foundry never holds a Dataverse token: the host that received Sami's token runs the tool, so Dataverse trims rows to Sami.
